Process

From spec to merge.

  1. 01

    The spec.

    A task arrives as a request or a proposed change in the repository, possibly already clarified in Anvil.

  2. 02

    A plan for approval.

    Forge breaks down the approach and waits for your approval.

  3. 03

    Code and tests.

    It writes the code and the tests from the plan, and checks its own work before saving the changes.

  4. 04

    Code review.

    It addresses the review comments and verifies the fixes again.

  5. 05

    Browser verification.

    Temper clicks through the finished change.

  6. 06

    Merge.

    Only a person merges the changes, with the “Merge” button.

Work

How Forge works.

  • Approve on a phone too.

    A task waits for approval, and you see its plan broken down into steps on a phone as well.

  • A fix or a whole backlog.

    Linked tasks run as a batch or a chain.

  • Documentation keeps pace.

    Documentation is updated along with the code.

  • A person always merges.

    Nothing is merged without approval.

At Cognera

A factory we work in ourselves.
